compos.text: Alt text: "Description of MobileNation Visual Voicemail features. Text reads: 'MobileNation Visual Voicemail allows you to listen and manage your voicemail messages directly from your mobile phone. With MobileNation Visual Voicemail there is no need to call your voice mailbox or listen to your messages sequentially. Instead, as soon as a new message is deposited, MobileNation Visual Voicemail automatically copies it onto your phone and deposits it into your Visual Voicemail Inbox. This allows you to browse and listen to your voice messages in any order and at any time.'"

compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is a welcome page for MobileNation Visual Voicemail. It explains the main features of the service, which allows users to listen to and manage their voicemail messages directly from their mobile phone without needing to call their voicemail box. The service automatically copies new messages to the phone and deposits them into the Visual Voicemail Inbox, enabling users to browse and listen to their messages in any order and at any time. At the bottom of the screen, there are two navigation buttons labeled "Previous" and "Next" for moving through the setup or information process.
